releaseNotes:
✨ What's new in v2.6:
• 💳 Seamless Native UPI Payments: Added complete native deep-link delegation for PhonePe, Paytm, GPay, and other UPI apps to eliminate WebView crashes and make checkouts lightning-fast!
• 🛠️ Razorpay Checkout & Refund Improvements: Seamlessly integrated standard live payment and refund APIs, optimizing transaction security and reliability.
